subject: MAP: Integration build plan — SDK, streaming, tool calling (draft)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools)

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs). I summarized the key items below and added milestone placeholders so we can map owners and the target close date.

Summary / asks:
- Target close (customer go-live): we discussed early Oct; putting a tentative target close date of 2026-10-15. Please confirm.
- Milestones (draft):
  1) SDK PoC (Redwood + ACME): sample SDK + quickstart (owner: TBD)
  2) Streaming & KV/cache validation: throughput tests with sample dataset (owner: TBD)
  3) Tool calling integration: connect to ACME search tool for retrieval + structured output (owner: TBD)
  4) Security & privacy sign-off (ACME Sec + Redwood Sec)
  5) Legal / DSAs signed
- Dependencies: ACME to provide sample request/response schema, API keys for staging, and security questionnaire answers. Redwood will provide SDK artifact, integration notes, and a streaming POC plan.

Please review the attached MAP (integration-map-MAP-v0.3.xlsx) and let me know:
- any missing milestones or dependencies
- who on your side should own each milestone (I flagged Samira for privacy/security)
- whether the 2026-10-15 target close makes sense or needs to shift

Next steps: if that looks right, I’ll loop in the engineering leads (Dev / Dylan) to assign internal owners and propose milestone dates.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: integration-map-MAP-v0.3.xlsx
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Target close: we’re aiming for a production pilot in mid-October; can we move the close date to 2026-10-20 to allow an extra week for legal/ops?
- Additional milestone: privacy review by ACME Security (Samira) — please include a specific sign-off task and timeline.
- Tool calling: our internal search service needs a small adapter. We need to surface structured outputs that map to our search schema (I attached ACME API requirements).

Owners on ACME side: I’ll own overall program and coordinate legal; Samira will own privacy/security sign-off.

Please assign Redwood engineering owners and share an updated milestone schedule.

Best,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Product Integrations — ACME Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

Attachment: acme-api-contract-reqs.pdf

Subject: Fwd: MAP draft — please assign owners & timeline

Hi Dev / Dylan — forwarding the ACME MAP draft and Alex/Samira notes. High level asks:

- Dev: can you own SDK integration (deliverable: SDK PoC + docs + sample app)?
- Dylan: can you own streaming + tool calling (deliverable: streaming POC, tool-calling adapter for ACME search, structured output mapping)?

Key dependencies: ACME to provide sample schema and staging API keys; security questionnaire to be completed for key exchange. I’ve uploaded the MAP to the shared folder (link below) and attached the current draft.

Please reply with proposed milestone dates (POC, internal review, GA) and any blockers. I need an internal owners/timeline update to send back to Alex by end of next week.

Links:
- Shared MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-MAP
- DocuSign (legal placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/link/ACME-MAP-signature

Thanks,
Marissa

- SDK PoC (internal): 2026-08-15 — deliver a sample SDK binary, quickstart, and sample app using ACME sample payloads.
- SDK Integration Test with ACME staging: 2026-09-07 — run integration tests with provided staging keys/samples.
- SDK GA (ship to production config): 2026-09-30 — docs, integration tests, and release notes.

Blockers / needs:
- ACME to provide sample request/response schemas and staging API keys by 2026-07-30.
- Security to sign off on key exchange; I’ll coordinate with security but need Samira to confirm requirements.
